# Leonida Tours

> Independent South Florida tour company running unofficial small-group and private tours to the real Miami, Everglades and Florida Keys places that inspired the game world of Leonida (Vice City). Tours start mid-November 2026 (launch day 2026-11-19). Reservations are free with nothing to pay upfront. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

- Home base: Ocean Drive, Miami Beach, Florida, USA
- Email: hello@leonidatours.com
- Instagram / TikTok: @leonidatours
- Reserve: https://leonidatours.com/#preregister

## Tours

- [Miami Vice City Small-Group Tour](https://leonidatours.com/tours/miami-small-group-tour/): $79 per person, 3 hours · day or night, group Up to 12, departs Day 10a & 2p · Night 6:30p, meets Ocean Drive. Real place: Miami. Our signature tour, by day or by night. Take a daytime departure, or the sunset + night run that starts at golden hour and finishes as the neon switches on. The spots that inspired eight trailer scenes, in one loop: the Ocean Drive neon, the Venetian Causeway, downtown, the Wynwood murals, Little Haiti, Little Havana and the Brickell skyline.
- [Private Classic Convertible Tour](https://leonidatours.com/tours/private-classic-convertible-tour-miami/): $600 per car, 2.5 hours, group Up to 3, departs Your time, meets Hotel pickup. Real place: Miami. The most cinematic way to see it. Just your crew in a top-down vintage convertible with a driver-guide who knows every angle. Same stops as the signature tour, at your pace.
- [Private Jeep Convertible Tour](https://leonidatours.com/tours/private-jeep-tour-miami/): $450 per Jeep, 2.5 hours, group Up to 3, departs Your time, meets Hotel pickup. Real place: Miami. Roof off, wind in. Your crew in an open-top Jeep with a driver-guide, running the full Miami loop from the Ocean Drive neon to the Brickell skyline.
- [Miami Vice City by Boat](https://leonidatours.com/tours/miami-boat-tour-biscayne-bay/): $79 per person, 2 hours, group Up to 12, departs 11a · 4p · sunset, meets Bayside Marina. Real place: Biscayne Bay. Our Millionaire’s Row cruise. Loop out of Bayside past PortMiami, Fisher Island and the Miami Beach Marina megayachts, then the celebrity mansions of Star, Palm and Hibiscus Islands and the Venetian Islands, before a golden-hour hold on the skyline.
- [Grasslands Airboat](https://leonidatours.com/tours/everglades-airboat-tour-from-miami/): $79 per person, 4 hours, group Up to 20, departs 9a · 1p, meets Pickup in Miami. Real place: The Everglades. Leave the neon behind for the swamp that inspired the game’s wetlands. Round-trip shuttle from Miami, then an airboat run through the Everglades sawgrass with a wildlife guide. Add an alligator farm visit, or stay for a glow-in-the-dark ATV ride after sunset.
- [Leonida Keys Road Trip](https://leonidatours.com/tours/florida-keys-day-trip-from-miami/): $149 per person, Full day, group Up to 12, departs 7:30a, meets Pickup in Miami. Real place: Florida Keys. The island road that inspired the game’s Keys. Drive the Overseas Highway through Key Largo and Islamorada to the Seven Mile Bridge, with beach time and a seafood lunch stop.
- [Leonida City Pass](https://leonidatours.com/tours/leonida-city-pass/): $199 per person, Book each date, group Any size, departs Your schedule, meets Varies. Real place: Streets, bay & swamp. The Miami Vice City small-group tour, Miami Vice City by Boat and the Grasslands Airboat, booked on your own schedule. A $237 value for $199.

## Miami Vice City tour stops (in order)

1. Ocean Drive (the neon hotel strip): Meet on the Art Deco strip the first trailer’s look is built on: pastel hotels, neon signage and the Clevelander corner.
2. Lummus Park Beach (the beach scenes): The candy-colored lifeguard towers and the sand from the beach scenes. Crew photo stop.
3. Venetian Causeway (the causeway drive): Island-hop across the bay on the old drawbridge causeway, skyline rising ahead.
4. Downtown & Biscayne Blvd (the arena and the club): The waterfront arena, the color-changing crown of the tallest tower and the 24-hour superclub from the second trailer.
5. Wynwood (the arts district): A 25-minute walk through the murals and warehouse streets of the arts district.
6. Little Haiti (the Caribbean quarter): Caribbean color, murals and music. Stop by the cultural complex and taste a Haitian patty.
7. Little Havana (Calle Ocho): Cafecito and a pastelito at a ventanita, then the domino tables of Máximo Gómez Park.
8. Brickell (the skyline shots): The glass canyon of the financial district, then back over the MacArthur Causeway past PortMiami to Ocean Drive.

## FAQ

**Is this an official game tour?** No. Leonida Tours is an independent South Florida tour company running unofficial tours. We take you IRL to the real places that inspired the game's world. We are not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
**Why do you use names like Leonida?** Fans know these places by their in-game nicknames, so we use them to point you to the real spots that inspired them. Every stop is a real, public place in Miami, the Everglades or the Florida Keys.
**Do I need to be a gamer?** Not at all. Fans get the scene-by-scene details. Everyone else gets Miami Beach, downtown, Wynwood, Little Haiti, Little Havana, the Everglades and the Keys with a great local guide.
**What does reserving mean?** It's free and there's no payment today. We email you to confirm your date before public booking opens, plus 20% off your first tour.
**When do tours start?** Mid-November 2026. Miami tours run daily; the Grasslands (Everglades) and Leonida Keys trips run on set days each week.
**What's the difference between small group and private?** Small-group tours ride in a minibus with up to 12 guests and a host. Private tours are just your crew, up to 3 people, in a classic convertible ($600) or a Jeep convertible ($450) with a driver-guide.
**How does the City Pass work?** One pass covers the Miami Vice City small-group tour, the boat tour and the Grasslands airboat. Book each date whenever you like during your stay.
**What if it rains?** Every route has covered stops. If a storm cancels your tour, rebook for free or get a full refund.
